## 📌 Description
Integrate external test data sources (Excel and JSON) and leverage TestNG `@DataProvider` for parameterised execution.

## ✅ Tasks
- [ ] **Excel Utility**
- Add Apache POI (`poi-ooxml`) dependency
- `ExcelReader.java` – read XLSX files, return `Object[][]` for DataProvider
- Support cell types, formulas, and error handling

- [ ] **JSON Utility**
- Add Jackson Databind (`com.fasterxml.jackson.core`)
- `JsonReader.java` – map JSON arrays to `List<Map<String, Object>>`

- [ ] **DataProvider Examples**
- Create `DataProviderClass.java` with methods `getTodoDataFromExcel`, `getTodoDataFromJson`
- Use on `TC_002` to run with multiple todo items (e.g., 3 different inputs)

- [ ] **Test Enhancement**
- Parameterise test methods – accept `String todoText`, `boolean shouldComplete`, etc.
- Log which data set is being executed

- [ ] **Resource Management**
- Store sample Excel and JSON files under `src/test/resources/testdata/`
- Close streams properly (try‑with‑resources)

## 🔍 Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Same test runs multiple times with different data sets (visible in TestNG report)
- [ ] Both Excel and JSON data providers work seamlessly
- [ ] CI pipeline includes parsing of test data files

## 📎 Dependencies
- [ ] v0.3.0 (Page Object Model) must be stable

## 🧪 Testing
- [ ] Run `mvn test -Dtest=TC_002` – 3 iterations appear in Surefire reports
- [ ] Corrupt Excel file triggers a meaningful error message
- [ ] `pom-validator.sh` accepts new dependencies (pass for v0.4.0 requirements)
